# system.compile

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.3</span></div>

Compile the lua script into luac.

```lua
system.compile(path[, strip])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ``path`` | string | yes | lua source file |
| ``strip`` | boolean | optional (default `false`) | strip debug infor from the compiled file |

## Returns

Nothing.

## Real-world usage

<div class="api-usage">Called 5 times across 2 open-source Ethos Lua projects. A few short excerpts:</div>

=== "Example 1"

    ```lua
    system.compile("i18n/en.lua")
    ```

    <small>[gps-qrcode/i18n/i18n.lua:5](https://github.com/flyingeek/ethos-gps-qrcode/blob/e70f80b85f48b00414d84d42a133d5a14a3c0862/gps-qrcode/i18n/i18n.lua#L5-L5)</small>

=== "Example 2"

    ```lua
    local function compileIfNeeded(source)
        if os.stat(source) then
            system.compile(source)
        end
    end
    ```

    <small>[src/bmfa-caller/main.lua:1](https://github.com/robthomson/ethos-bmfa-caller/blob/f4bb5511dbe666567fc5406ca60124be65b9c830/src/bmfa-caller/main.lua#L1-L5)</small>

=== "Example 3"

    ```lua
    local QR
    system.compile("lib/ethos-qrencode.lua") -- compile but defer load to create
    ```

    <small>[gps-qrcode/main.lua:17](https://github.com/flyingeek/ethos-gps-qrcode/blob/e70f80b85f48b00414d84d42a133d5a14a3c0862/gps-qrcode/main.lua#L17-L18)</small>
